end.summary:
Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
Used examples such as a flagpole and a slide.
4 of 6 attempts were unaided correct.
The difference between straight and slanting was mixed up, then clarified later using direction and the absence of curves.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the three line directions with familiar examples and checked whether a line was straight or curved. Om correctly described a standing line as going up and down and later identified a slanting straight line as slide-like, without a curve. The early mix-up between “straight” and “slanting” was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Om to find and name one standing, one sleeping and one slanting line in everyday objects.
